## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser. Nothing to install.
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** the **tasks PDF** with your answers, before lecture 10.
  About 30 minutes.
- **The course project starts here:** you choose one service (Task 1 a).
  In Online activity 12 you make the slides of your service.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary digital-service online-form question-type form-response >}}

## The four services of the project {.study}

Choose **one** service. All its facts are given.

| | Service | Kind | The questions of its form |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | **Study Room**: book the library study room | booking | Your name (Text) · Day (Choice) · Time (Choice) · Number of students (Number) |
| **B** | **Easy Print**: order printing | online form | Your name (Text) · What to print (Choice) · Pages (Number) · Pick-up day (Date) |
| **C** | **Fix It**: book a phone repair | booking | Your name (Text) · Phone (Choice) · Problem (Choice) · Day (Date) |
| **D** | **Green Bites**: order a lunch box | online form | Your name (Text) · Lunch (Choice) · Boxes (Number) · Day (Date) |

: The four services of the course project (made up).

## Step 1 · Build the form and share its link {.study}

- **New Form**, then the title (the name of the service).
- **+ Add new** for each question: **Choice** (with its options), **Text**,
  **Date**. Turn on **Required** for the important questions.
- **Collect responses** gives the **link** (Copy) and a **QR code**.

{{< sim file="sims/forms-gym.html" poster="sims/forms-gym.png" title="Forms Lab: the gym booking form" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Questions"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Text|Date"}
In Green Bites, which question type is "Lunch: chicken, falafel or salad"?
:   Choice

    Why: The customer chooses one of the options.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · The responses in a sheet {.study}

- Each **response** (one filled-in form) is **one row** of a sheet.
- **Responses** shows how many people answered, with charts.
- **Open results in Excel** opens the sheet.

{{< sim file="sims/forms-responses.html" poster="sims/forms-responses.png" title="Forms Lab: the responses in a sheet" height="760" >}}
